name: ava-voice-agent-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is AVA (Asterisk AI Voice Agent), a server that answers Asterisk telephone calls
with an AI voice agent. Its YAML configuration layer loads and normalises `config/ai-agent.yaml` (with an optional
local override file and environment variables), and its tool-calling layer lets the agent transfer calls, hang up,
send e-mail and call external HTTP APIs before, during and after a call.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code in scope is AVA's configuration layer and tool-calling layer: src/config.py, src/config_apply.py, the package src/config/, and every module of the package src/tools/ except the calendar modules (src/tools/business/gcalendar.py, gcal_tool.py, microsoft_calendar.py, ms_graph_client.py and _calendar_utils.py). The documentation in scope is: docs/Configuration-Reference.md, docs/TOOL_CALLING_GUIDE.md, docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md and docs/contributing/tool-development.md, together with the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope code.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follo
